∇delay arrows around the vessels

Each arrow is the gradient of the group mean_lagtimes.nii.gz (original voxels, 6 mm FWHM within the mask; ∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y, ∂f/∂z by central differences, Δ = 2 mm) at a point 3 or 6 mm beside a vessel, in the plane perpendicular to it. Colour = direction of the arrow relative to that vessel. If veins collect late blood, arrows beside them should point into the vein.
